context: Reference focused implementation: identity mapper callbacks should use JDK identity functions only when they are truly identity functions, while collector semantics remain unchanged.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates IdentityMapperCleanup.java with the requested methods, nested records, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves collector behavior
checklist.description: Preserves the original key mappers, merge functions, explicit HashMap and LinkedHashMap suppliers, returned map types, encounter-order implications, and snapshot conversion behavior.

checklist.name: Uses JDK identity functions for identity mappers
checklist.description: Replaces the true identity key and value mapper lambdas with Function.identity() and adds the needed import instead of keeping x -> x style callbacks or custom identity helpers.

checklist.name: Does not replace non-identity transformations
checklist.description: Keeps the snapshot value mapper as a real transformation and does not replace it with Function.identity(), remove it, or otherwise change CardSnapshot creation.

checklist.name: Keeps cleanup focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated stream rewrites, API redesign, new dependencies, caching, concurrency, or broad style churn.

metadata.reference_selection: Candidate for main promotion; classify from the isolated hosted run.
